body.title: Telecom, networking and IT, by one team.
paragraphs: Nexatel Private Limited is a specialist company in telecom systems, electrical installations, network cabling and IT hardware supply and installation in India, currently delivering major projects in Kerala. The company is led by a management team and engineers who have spent their careers in these fields.

Our pitch is straightforward. We save you time and money, and we keep your operation running smoothly while we work. We take responsibility for delivering the requirement at top quality, backed by support from people who feel like part of your team. The OEMs we work with give us strong commercial backing, and that translates into honest pricing and quick lead times for the clients we serve.
